title: Agent tool selection
description: Decide which tool an agent should call next, how urgent the step is, and whether the step requires a tool at all. The choice task is the tool. The score task is urgency, not complexity: the generator's phrase banks are tone-shaped (calm → urgent), so an axis that is not urgency would label urgent-sounding text as something else. That is a documented design decision, see BACKLOG B-5.

instructions.choice: Which tool should the agent use next?

option_descriptions.code: running scripts, tests, builds, refactors, and debugging steps
option_descriptions.files: reading or writing files, uploads, downloads, exports, and archives
option_descriptions.other: everything else: summaries, translations, scheduling, drafts, and asking the user
option_descriptions.search: web searches, documentation lookups, research steps, and reference answers
